protocol.cohort: All 11775 consecutive pairs from workload study 1; both years >=20 games and >=500 minutes.
protocol.rateUnits: Shots=FGA+0.44FTA, assists and turnovers per36; subtract each season's league rate before differencing.
protocol.conditioning: Observed after-season shots, assists and minutes changes are allowed. This is conditional association, not a preseason forecast.
protocol.fixedTurnovers: Hold raw prior TOV/36 fixed; subtract the actual change in league TOV/36 for the relative-change prediction.
protocol.shotLinkedTurnovers: Scale raw prior TOV/36 by raw after/prior shot rate; subtract actual league TOV/36 change.
protocol.fit: Reuse training-only standardized ridge alpha1 for conditional evaluations. No tuning; no clipping of predictions.
protocol.heldOutPlayerRule: int(SHA256(UTF8(playerId)),16)%5==0; same already-exposed partitions as prediction study1.
protocol.comparison: shots minus context; shotsAndAssists minus shots; paired equal-pair MSE with player-cluster normal intervals.
protocol.descriptiveFit: Unpenalized OLS intercept with shotChange and assistChange only; player-cluster CR1 covariance, normal1.96 intervals.
protocol.stableExposure: Ages20-34 both years, after/prior mpg ratio0.8-1.2 inclusive; sameTeam/stable flags reuse workload study1.
protocol.teamChange: Both seasons single raw-team label, different labels; renames may look like changes. Not randomized teammate treatment.
protocol.directions: decreased if <=-threshold, increased if >=threshold, similar otherwise; all nine stable-cohort cells retained.

limitations: Observed after-season features are intentional conditioning, not future information available to a preseason forecast.
Repeatedly exposed source seasons and model partitions; this is diagnostic reuse, not new independent validation.
No causal turnover response, maximum capacity or five-player portability. Assists are incomplete proxies for handling and passing.
Shared per-minute denominators, measurement error, role selection, injury, aging and team/season shocks remain; cluster intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.
Team changes are observational raw-label changes, not randomized teammate changes; no teammate treatment variable is constructed.
Both-season exposure filters select survivors. No pre-1978 imputation, win-band fitting or live/prototype policy changes.
